about_the_game:
A horror puzzle exploration game

【 Gameplay】

Avoid the enemies chasing you, search for and collect props, solve the puzzles in the scene, and finally unlock the door to escape

【 Story】

One day, when you woke up, you found that the door of your own home was locked, and some strange props and ventilation ducts leading to other Spaces appeared in your house.

What's worse, your wife seems to be in a bad state. If you run away directly, it might lead to consequences you don't want to see.

【About the Trial Version】

Compared with the full version, the trial version does not have a plot demonstration section, and the core gameplay does not have a function to restore the wife's condition. The game can only be ended when the situation deteriorates to a certain extent

【 Feature: Intimacy Value System】

It is necessary to maintain the intimacy value of your wife to ensure that she is not eroded by darkness; otherwise, she will chase after you and hit your head. Under different intimacy values, the wife will take different action logics

(PS: In the trial version, once your wife is slightly eroded (that is, he starts hitting you and you have no effective means to restore the intimacy value)

【Hint】

In the game, you need to pay attention to the interaction prompts. They usually tell you what items you need to interact with to advance the process.

content_descriptors.notes:
